conditions.label: Austria advance
conditions.detail: Worth ~30-60 group pts on ALL THREE tickets plus the knockout door. Decided 17 / 22 / 27 Jun. Top two qualify and even 3rd can sneak through (8 of 12 thirds do).

conditions.label: Result v Argentina
conditions.detail: A draw = +80, a win = +160 — and we hold Austria on all three tickets. Mon 22 Jun, 6pm UK, Dallas. The single biggest group-stage moment we own.

conditions.label: France win it all
conditions.detail: The engine of T1+T3: a title run is ~1,000+ pts BEFORE the joker doubles it. Only banks on 19 July. Checkpoints: Norway 26 Jun (+80 becomes +160 doubled), then every knockout at rating ×4.

conditions.label: Spain to the final
conditions.detail: T2's doubled joker and T1's second giant. Reaching the final is ~700+ pts. Watch: Uruguay 26 Jun, then a knockout half containing Belgium and Germany.

conditions.label: Morocco QF run
conditions.detail: The Brazil opener (Sat 13) is the prize: draw +85, win +170, on two tickets. A 2022-style quarter-final run is ~400+ pts each. Goals pay 3/6.

conditions.label: Colombia QF run
conditions.detail: South America's second-top scorers — goals pay 3 (6 in knockouts). Portugal game = 70/140. A quarter-final run is ~400+ pts on two tickets.

conditions.label: Canada KO win
conditions.detail: The group is soft (Qatar, Bosnia) — the real value is ONE home-soil knockout win at opponent rating ×4, plus clean-sheet bonuses along the way.

conditions.label: DR Congo points
conditions.detail: Goals (+3 each) and the Uzbekistan decider on 27 Jun. The win itself pays little, but advancing as a third-place team opens a ×4 knockout payday.

conditions.label: Saudi beat Panama & SAF
conditions.detail: Our tiebreak against the clones: we out-rank Ben Corry 2 only if Saudi out-score Panama, and Robert White 3 only if they beat South Africa's total. Every Saudi goal and clean sheet is a point ON the clones.

conditions.label: England to the final
conditions.detail: T2's second path: England's half runs through Brazil (+340) and Argentina (+320) at ×4. A final appearance is ~650+ pts.

conditions.label: Panama nick a result
conditions.detail: A draw v Croatia = +12; a draw v ENGLAND = +90. Plus goals. Any point Panama takes is nearly pure profit on T2.

conditions.label: Argentina to the final
conditions.detail: T3's other engine: a run to the final is ~700+ pts. The Austria game (22 Jun) pays us twice — we hold both sides of it.

conditions.label: Japan deep run
conditions.detail: Beat Germany AND Spain in 2022. A Netherlands result = 50/100; a last-16-or-better run is ~300+ pts on T3.

conditions.label: Uruguay deep run
conditions.detail: The Spain game (26 Jun) is the 100/200 lottery ticket; after that every knockout win pays rating ×4.

conditions.label: Ivory Coast advance
conditions.note: just beat France in a friendly
conditions.detail: Literally beat France in a friendly last week. A Germany draw = +60; advancing buys a ×4 knockout shot.

conditions.label: Uzbekistan into last 32
conditions.detail: Third place can be enough — 8 of 12 thirds advance. The DR Congo decider (27 Jun) likely settles it. Advancing = a bonus knockout game.

conditions.label: Cape Verde get a result
conditions.detail: The Saudi decider (27 Jun) plus goals along the way. A surprise point off Uruguay (+15) would be gravy on T3.
